spec.command:
bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/tax_error_inject_agent && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 swift sft \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --dataset data/mini_pipeline/sft_vanilla_aligned.jsonl \
  --lora_rank 16 \
  --lora_alpha 32 \
  --lora_dropout 0.05 \
  --target_modules all-linear \
  --num_train_epochs 1 \
  --learning_rate 1e-4 \
  --per_device_train_batch_size 1 \
  --gradient_accumulation_steps 16 \
  --warmup_ratio 0.05 \
  --seed 42 \
  --max_length 4096 \
  --gradient_checkpointing true \
  --output_dir checkpoints/vanilla_sft_aligned \
  --logging_steps 5 \
  --logging_first_step true \
  --save_strategy epoch \
  --bf16 true \
  --weight_decay 0.1 \
  --adam_beta1 0.9 \
  --adam_beta2 0.95 \
  --max_grad_norm 1.0 \
  --lr_scheduler_type cosine \
  --optim adamw_torch_fused 2>&1"
